subject: VPC commercial: rebate & support bundling inquiry
messages:
From: Sanjay Rao <sanjay.rao@healthbridge.ai>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: procurement@healthbridge.ai
Date: 2027-06-14T09:12:00Z
Subject: VPC commercial - rebate & support bundling question

Hi Tessa,

Thanks again for the demo last week. We ran the pilot on two sites and the execs asked me to follow up on pricing: specifically whether Redwood can offer a rebate on the platform fee if we commit to a 3-site rollout (pilot -> staging -> prod) and whether that rebate can be tied to a higher support tier (SLA 99.9 + 4hr P1 response).

Two quick constraints from our side:
- procurement requires a single contract and an attached SOW (we've attached an internal draft to this mail).
- we'd like a consolidated invoice monthly, not separate invoices per site.

Can you outline options (standard vs. committed rebate) and any limits on burst capacity / node allocation for private deployments? We're preparing a procurement packet for next Wed.

Best,
Sanjay
Director of IT 
HealthBridge Labs

Attachment: HealthBridge_internal_SOW_draft.docx (stub)

From: Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwoodinference.com>
To: Sanjay Rao <sanjay.rao@healthbridge.ai>
Cc: ben_carter@redwoodinference.com, marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com
Date: 2027-06-14T14:05:00Z
Subject: Re: VPC commercial - rebate & support bundling question

Hi Sanjay — thanks for the clear ask and context. High level: yes, we can structure a platform-fee rebate tied to staged site activation. Below is a concise set of options so you can pick what maps to your procurement packet. I've attached a simplified pricing_model.xlsx so you can run the math.

Option A (Conservative) — Pilot to Prod Commitment
- 12 month commitment, 2x pilot footprint -> 3-site conversion within 90 days
- Platform fee rebate: 10% off platform fee in month 1-6, 5% month 7-12
- Support: Standard SRE Retainer (oncall business hours) included; SLA uplift available at add-on pricing
- Invoicing: consolidated monthly invoice for all sites

Option B (Committed Growth) — Higher rebate for step-up
- 24 month commitment, guaranteed node capacity for burst (up to +25% baseline)
- Platform fee rebate: 20% for first 12 months if all 3 sites accepted within 120 days
- Support: SLA 99.9, 4hr P1 response included as part of the package (limited to 4seats SRE)
- Implementation and SOW milestones tied to credits for migration work

Notes / constraints:
- Rebates are applied against the monthly platform fee, not per-node operator licenses.
- Burst capacity guarantees require a brief sizing call with our infra team to reserve capacity pools (we can keep this as part of the SOW).

Next steps: if either A or B is interesting, I can loop in our finance/legal to provide a procurement-ready SOW and sample contract language.

Regards,
Tessa Morgan
Senior Enterprise AE
Redwood Inference

Attachment: pricing_model.xlsx (stub)

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwoodinference.com>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwoodinference.com>, Sanjay Rao <sanjay.rao@healthbridge.ai>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com
Date: 2027-06-15T10:03:00Z
Subject: Re: VPC commercial - rebate & support bundling question

Adding a quick note from pricing ops — we can approve Option B for HealthBridge as a standard counteroffer but need the following to be acceptable to finance/legal:
- A minimum annual committed spend threshold (proposed $480k ARR)
- A clear acceptance definition for "site accepted" (we typically use smoke-test + SRE sign off)
- Limits on burst (we can do +25% baseline for 12 months; beyond that we consider temporary credits or reserved capacity)

Tessa — if Sanjay confirms the acceptance criteria, I'll draft the revenue concessions and MX line items. Sanjay — happy to hop on a quick call today if helpful.

Ben Carter
VP, Enterprise Sales Ops
Redwood Inference

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Sanjay Rao <sanjay.rao@healthbridge.ai>, Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: ben_carter@redwoodinference.com, david_kim@redwoodinference.com
Date: 2027-06-17T09:40:00Z
Subject: Re: VPC commercial - rebate & support bundling question

Hi all — attached is a procurement-friendly bundle with line-item pricing and two commercial paths: 

Committed Growth (preferred)
- Term: 24 months
- Upfront: none required if contract executes within 30 days of SOW sign-off
- Platform fee rebate: 20% applied months 1-12; 10% months 13-24 if 3-site activation confirmed
- SRE Support: SLA 99.9 + 4hr P1 response; includes 4 SRE seats for incident triage and playbook runbook creation
- Implementation credits: $40k migration credit applied on invoice after site-2 acceptance

Flexible Pilot
- Term: 12 months
- Platform fee rebate: 10% months 1-6, 5% months 7-12
- Support: Standard retainer (business hours) with 8x5 response times; SLA uplift available as add-on

Procurement details: consolidated monthly invoicing, single PO acceptable. I've also uploaded a redline-friendly attachment (redlines_20270617.docx) with suggested contract language for acceptance criteria and burst definitions. If these terms look right, I'll prepare a DocuSign-ready agreement and include the HubSpot deal id in the footer.

Marissa Cole
Senior Commercial Counsel
Redwood Inference

Attachments: redlines_20270617.docx (stub), HealthBridge_pricing_bundle_20270617.xlsx (stub)

P.S. David, please confirm there are no infra constraints on the burst language above (cc'd).

From: David Kim <david_kim@redwoodinference.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>, Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwoodinference.com>, Sanjay Rao <sanjay.rao@healthbridge.ai>
Cc: ben_carter@redwoodinference.com
Date: 2027-06-17T15:22:00Z
Subject: Re: VPC commercial - rebate & support bundling question

Marissa / Sanjay — quick infra check. The proposed +25% burst for 12 months is feasible provided we reserve capacity in us-west for your expected regions. Two operational points: 
1) We need a 30-day lead to stand up reserved pools (we'll provide exact node counts after sizing call).
2) For SLA 99.9 + 4hr P1, we require runbook handoff and a joint on-call roster for the first 90 days; this is standard for private deployments where we accept incident escalation.

If HealthBridge signs for Committed Growth, engineering will schedule a sizing call next week and we'll provide a capacity reservation plan that maps to the pricing sheet.

-David
David Kim
Director, Solutions Engineering
Redwood Inference
